message: Ok here's the new contract for $300 with milestones based on scene. I uploaded a new script to the shared google folder which only has a few small changes from the last one. You don't need to do the text cards - I can do those myself - so we may end up with a little extra funds for fine tuning but let's see how it goes. Let me know if you have any questions. Thanks!

Ppl

I do want that opening aerial establishing shot but it's not as high a priority so we can wait and make sure we get everything else we need before spending time on it.

Is it worth generating new set images to use as starting frames so we get higher quality sets? I"m ok with that if it would help. I didn't know we would be stuck with the resolution of my set images and I don't think they're high enough quality.
Yes, here is the hero in a distant perspective, his details are not visible, but it is marked.
I asked as a clarification because it will be important later if you want to add your voiceover. It's better to take this into account right away in the timing of the shots.

First set are wide, second set are mid, third set are closer
Ok

Sorry my language was probably unclear (using "set" with different meanings). There are three PAIRS of images. Each pair of images is 1 shot of Q and 1 shot of Deadwax. The first two images are long/wide, the second two images are mid, and the third pair of shots is closer (waist up).
